hifi_apple_music.description: Apple Music content via a paired companion; authorization stays on-device. For exact playback use hifi_search/hifi_play_ref. Feedback must be explicit; never infer dislike from skips.

action.description: catalog_search, library, playlists, playlist_tracks, recent, recommendations, favorites, queue_plan, queue_append, play_next, context, clear_feedback, playlist_create, playlist_update, playlist_add, playlist_remove, favorite_add, favorite_remove, feedback.

confirm.description: Explicit user confirmation; true required for account mutations, feedback, clear_feedback.

id.description: Content/playlist ID; fallback ref for feedback/play_next.

idempotency_key.description: Required retry key for companion account mutations; reuse on retry.

items.description: Ordered opaque search refs for queue_plan/queue_append.

precondition.description: Companion revision/ownership object from a prior read.

playlist_version.description: Playlist revision returned by a prior companion read.

signal.description: Explicit favorite, unfavorite, rating, skip, more_like_this, less_like_this.

source.description: Feedback source: user (default and only accepted value).

uri.description: Content URI; opaque search ref for feedback/play_next.

hifi_capabilities.description: Check support: supported = wired; unsupported = protocol limit, do not retry; not_implemented = UHC gap (tracked_by). Check has_volume_control separately for device volume.

zone_id.description: Zone ID; omit for all zones/providers.

hifi_collections.description: Browse Roon, LMS, or Music Assistant libraries, playlists, favorites, and live radio. Use returned location/path to navigate and ref with hifi_play_ref to play. Spotify/Apple Music collections use their provider tools.

location.description: Durable browse location; omit when using path.

media_type.description: radio for live stations (Roon: My Live Radio); favorites default to tracks.

path.description: Short-lived browse continuation; omit when using location.

hifi_control.description: Control zone transport or volume. Check hifi_capabilities for provider support. Linked-zone volume controls the linked device.

action.description: play, pause, playpause, next, previous, repeat_off, repeat_context, repeat_track, shuffle_on, shuffle_off, volume_set, volume_up, volume_down, seek. HQPlayer also: stop, mute. Seek: Roon/HQPlayer only.

value.description: Seek: required finite, non-negative seconds. Volume_set: required; provider scale (0-100 or HQPlayer dB); linked devices use dB. Up/down default: 5, or linked-device step.

hifi_devices.description: Inspect amplifiers/receivers, link zones, or control power, input, and volume. Linking redirects zone volume to the device. Inputs switch only on select_input; success requires device confirmation. Diagnostics stay local; report returns a redacted preview for the user to submit.

action.description: list, links, link, unlink, set_ceiling, control, set_recording, report, clear_report.

ceiling.description: Maximum dB; omit to clear. Can only lower device limit.

command.description: For control: power_on, power_off, power_toggle, select_input, volume_set, volume_up, volume_down, mute, unmute.

device_id.description: Required for link/set_ceiling/report; control: this or zone_id, never both.

enabled.description: For set_recording: opt in to local recording (default off); false stops and forgets.

input.description: For select_input: input ID or name.

muted.description: For mute: true/false; omit to toggle.

sections.description: Report sections: environment, anomalies, device_state, excerpts. Default excludes excerpts.

source_id.description: For link: device input ID from list.

value.description: Control volume level/step in dB; relative default: device step.

zone_id.description: Required for link/unlink; or linked control target.

hifi_hqplayer_load_profile.description: Load a saved configuration and restart HQPlayer.

hifi_hqplayer_output_control.description: Configure HQPlayer output routing. Read hifi_hqplayer_outputs first; mutations require its source_epoch/output_revision except stop, discover, import_preview, setup_preview, and setup_readback.

action.description: relay_configure, route_add, route_update, route_remove, select, stop, discover, import_preview, import_apply, setup_preview, setup_apply, setup_readback, setup_rollback.

bind.description: Relay listen address; default LAN, automatic port.

correlation_id.description: Retry key: identical payload reuses operation; changed payload is refused.

discovery_interface.description: IPv4 discovery interface; auto-selected for enabled LAN relays.

hqp_allow.description: HQPlayer source allowlist; empty accepts any reachable NAA peer.

hifi_hqplayer_outputs.description: Read HQPlayer routes, relay state, revisions, and recent operations; operation_id selects one receipt.

operation_id.description: Receipt ID; omit for full routing state.

hifi_hqplayer_set_pipeline.description: Change a live HQPlayer setting. Read hifi_hqplayer_status for choices first. Changes do not save a profile.

setting.description: mode, samplerate, filter1x, filterNx, shaper, dither, junk_filter, matrix_profile, convolution, adaptive_volume, repeat, random.

hifi_hqplayer_status.description: Read HQPlayer status, pipeline settings, and available choices.

hifi_music_details.description: Read HiPhi Cloud source facts with provenance and attribution for current music; requires Cloud pairing. The first read can be slow. Check identity and stale/partial results; never present ambiguous candidate facts as certain.

language.description: Wiki language code, e.g. en; required, no default.

hifi_now_playing.description: Read a zone’s current track, playback state, and volume.

hifi_play.description: Search and play or queue the first match. For an exact selection, use hifi_search then hifi_play_ref.

action.description: play (default), queue, radio (Roon Radio, not live stations).

query.description: Music to search for. Plays the first match.

hifi_play_ref.description: Play an exact search/collection ref. If expired, search or browse again. Never invent or edit refs.

action.description: play (default), queue, radio (Roon Radio), next (LMS only).

ref.description: Opaque ref returned by search or collections.

zone_id.description: Target zone; same provider as ref, same owner for Apple Music.

hifi_queue.description: Read a queue (Roon: first 50 items, with truncation reported); edit Music Assistant queues with readback. Transfer requires two Music Assistant zones. Add items with hifi_play_ref or hifi_play action=queue.

action.description: read, jump, reorder, remove, clear, transfer.

item_id.description: Required for jump/reorder/remove; ID from queue read.

target_zone_id.description: Required for transfer; destination Music Assistant zone.

hifi_search.description: Search a zone’s library or catalog. Returns short-lived refs for exact playback with hifi_play_ref. Omit zone_id to search Roon.

query.description: Track, album, artist, or search text.

zone_id.description: Target zone; omit for Roon. Required to route to other providers.

hifi_spotify.description: Spotify playlists and saved tracks; writes need matching scopes. Browse requires Extended Quota (UHC_SPOTIFY_QUOTA_MODE=extended); unavailable in Development Mode. Search/play with hifi_search/hifi_play_ref.

action.description: playlists, playlist_tracks, saved_tracks, saved_tracks_check, saved_tracks_add, saved_tracks_remove, create_playlist, update_playlist, playlist_add, playlist_replace, playlist_remove; extended mode: browse_categories, browse_category_playlists, browse_featured_playlists, browse_new_releases.

hifi_status.description: Read bridge connection status for Roon and HQPlayer.

hifi_zone_group.description: Roon/LMS/Music Assistant sync groups. Join/leave require confirm=true and one provider. Roon members use roon:<output_id>; LMS leader_zone_id is a representative. Unreachable providers appear in errors.

confirm.description: Explicit user confirmation; true required for join/leave.

leader_zone_id.description: Required for join; same provider as members.

member_zone_ids.description: Required for join/leave; one provider, matching leader for join.

zone_id.description: Status provider filter; omit for all providers.

hifi_zones.description: List playback zones and their IDs, state, and volume.
